record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.original_question: For a germ tangent to the identity in C^n, describe its stable set in terms of characteristic directions, directors, indices, and any additional necessary invariants. In particular, determine how those data control which points converge to the origin, including phenomena not captured merely by convergence tangent to a characteristic direction.

evidence.quote: (OP14) Describe, using characteristic directions, directors, indices and possibly other invariants, the stable set of a germ tangent to the identity in C^n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:(\mathbb{C}^n,0)\to(\mathbb{C}^n,0)$ be a holomorphic germ tangent to the identity at the origin, i.e., $f(z)=z+P_\nu(z)+P_{\nu+1}(z)+\cdots$ where $\nu\ge 2$ and $P_\nu\not\equiv 0$ is the homogeneous part of lowest order $\ge 2$. Define the stable set
$$\mathcal{S}(f)=\{z\in U:\ f^k(z)\in U\text{ for all }k\ge 0\text{ and }f^k(z)\to 0\text{ as }k\to\infty\},$$
where $U$ is a sufficiently small neighborhood of $0$.

A nonzero vector $v\in\mathbb{C}^n$ (or its class $[v]\in\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$) is called a characteristic direction of $f$ if $P_\nu(v)=\lambda v$ for some $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$; it is non-degenerate when $\lambda\ne 0$ and degenerate when $\lambda=0$. To a non-degenerate characteristic direction $[v]$ one associates its directors (the eigenvalues of an associated linear endomorphism of $T_{[v]}\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$ obtained from the linearization of the induced map on the blow-up, suitably normalized) and a residual/Camacho–Sad–type index. After blowing up $0$, additional characteristic directions, directors and indices are inherited by the lifted germ along the exceptional divisor, and may be iterated under further modifications.

Problem. Give a complete description of the stable set $\mathcal{S}(f)$ purely in terms of:
(a) the characteristic directions of $f$ (and of its lifts under iterated blow-ups, including degenerate ones),
(b) the directors attached to those characteristic directions,
(c) the indices (such as residual/Camacho–Sad indices) attached to them, and
(d) any additional necessary holomorphic invariants of $f$.

The description should determine, for every point $z$ in a neighborhood of $0$, whether $z\in\mathcal{S}(f)$, and should account for orbits that converge to $0$ but are not tangent to any single characteristic direction (e.g., orbits attracted along degenerate directions, orbits whose accumulation set in $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$ is nontrivial, and other phenomena not captured solely by tangential convergence to a characteristic direction).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully describing the stable set of a germ tangent to the identity in $\mathbb{C}^n$ in terms of characteristic directions, directors and indices remains open. Substantial partial progress exists: Hakim's theorem gives parabolic basins along non-degenerate characteristic directions with directors of positive real part; Abate, Bracci, Tovena, Rong, Vivas, Lapan, Stensønes, Rivi and others have produced basins for various degenerate cases. Recent works (e.g., Mongodi–Bianchi 2021/2023) show that in dimension $\ge 3$ there exist isolated germs whose lifts admit only degenerate characteristic directions under any modification, indicating that a complete characterization in the spirit asked has not yet been achieved.

status_evidence.title: Birational properties of tangent to the identity germs without non-degenerate singular directions
status_evidence.snippet: There exists a family of isolated tangent to the identity germs f:(C^3,0)->(C^3,0) which have only degenerate characteristic directions, and the lift of f to any modification has only degenerate characteristic directions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2021/2023) work shows new obstructions in dimension >=3, indicating the global stable-set description is not complete.

status_evidence.title: Domain of attraction for maps tangent to the identity in C^2 with characteristic direction of higher degree
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs domains of attraction for tangent-to-identity maps in C^2 along certain degenerate characteristic directions under additional hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are available even in dimension 2 for degenerate directions.

status_evidence.title: Degenerate characteristic directions for maps tangent to the Identity
status_evidence.snippet: Studies basins of attraction associated to degenerate characteristic directions.
status_evidence.claim: The structure of the stable set associated to degenerate directions is still actively studied.
